props.meta:
Role: Videography, editing, grading
Place: Deutsches Haus, Flensburg
Cameras: Sony FX3, Sony A7 IV
Year: 2026

props.heading: Working with LEONA
props.text:
To support LEONA's festival applications and promotional campaign, I produced a series of cinematic live session videos that captured the atmosphere and emotion of her music. Filmed at the Deutsches Haus in Flensburg, the goal was to create an intimate performance setting that felt authentic while delivering high-end visual quality for festivals, promoters, and booking agencies.

The production was filmed using a multicam setup with the Sony FX3 and Sony A7 IV. Audio was recorded separately, professionally mixed and mastered, and then synchronized with the footage in post-production. I was responsible for the complete video production workflow - from camera setup and filming to editing, color grading, and the final delivery of the live session videos.
